message.content: In Blackjack, an Ace is a flexible card that can be valued at **either 1 or 11**, depending on which value gives the best advantage to your hand without causing a bust. This dual nature allows you to create “soft” hands (e.g., Ace‑7 = 18) that can still be improved by drawing another card. If you receive two Aces, you typically have the option to split them into separate hands, each starting with an Ace.
